audit.source: Dart VM getVMTimeline; final post-Hero profile recording
audit.scenario: 36 ADB swipes, 650ms duration, 250ms pause; 18 up then 18 down; full catalog loaded before recording
audit.interpretation: Frame 3345 exceeded the 16.667 ms raster budget. Its Rasterizer::DoDraw interval contains a long Canvas::saveLayer interval during SurfaceFrame::Encode. The trace localizes the delay to this raster operation; it does not establish whether the root cause was GPU/driver allocation, scheduling, or any specific widget. Nested durations must not be summed.
audit.limitations: This is a 120 ms excerpt, not the entire recording. Original B/E events and thread metadata are preserved. Events crossing excerpt boundaries may be incomplete. Timing spans are elapsed trace intervals, not CPU samples or a GPU hardware trace.
